title: Spencer’s portfolio · fresh technical concepts
question: Your earlier note was saved: you liked C and wanted it more technical. These fresh image concepts keep soft charcoal/red and portfolio-first hierarchy. Choose a draft or steer again; no previous selection is binding.

options.label: 1 · Spatial workbench
options.thesis: Project navigation becomes a precise field of dimensional planes.
options.viewport: Introduction left, project destinations in perspective right; a work gallery follows.
options.risk: The tile structure can feel too product-like without excellent portfolio content.

raised.raise: Interactive depth is purposeful and remains bounded to the opening.

options.label: 2 · Parametric atlas
options.thesis: A mathematical red surface makes the interactive field feel engineered.
options.viewport: Stable introduction left, dimensional red topology right, work immediately beneath.
options.risk: The surface must remain subordinate to real projects.
options.case: Closest to your preference for C; stronger technical structure while keeping its depth.

options.label: 3 · Procedural studio
options.thesis: A visible illustrative shader connects code to a precise living graphic.
options.viewport: Professional introduction beside a procedural field and its small illustrative code strip.
options.risk: The demonstration must be clearly labeled and never imply unverified experience.
options.case: Technical character comes from a real code/visual relationship.

options.case: Weaker professional identification and clarity than the leading concepts.
options.kept: Contrast in content density helps pace professional and creative material.
